comments.author: Amr Bachmid, Joost Kuijer - Amsterdam UMC
comments.description: WADQC 2 module for use with NIST MR phantom acquisitions

params.datetime_series_description: REQUIRED. Series description for retreiving datetime

params.NIST_series1_description: REQUIRED. The series description of scan with regular frequency encoding gradient polarity.
params.NIST_series2_description: REQUIRED. The series description of scan with reversed frequency encoding gradient polarity.
params.NIST_refPhantomDistX: Diameter X of a reference phantom (e.g. ACR). Linear distortion in X is transformed into a measurable distance.
params.NIST_refPhantomDistY: Diameter Y of a reference phantom (e.g. ACR). Linear distortion in Y is transformed into a measurable distance.
params.NIST_refPhantomDistZ: Length Z of a reference phantom (e.g. ACR). Linear distortion in Z is transformed into a measurable distance.
params.NIST_output_all_individual_markers: If True: output all images of all individual fudicial markers (will add toward load times).
params.NIST_fixed_plot_axes: If True: Axes on plots are fixed at x-lim (-2,2)
